reviews.text: really quick to prescribe anesthesia. WAY over priced and staff is weird and rude! save your time and go somewhere else. they make you feel like they only want your money and it looks like thats the clear reason with the Porsche and Alfa Romeo in the parking lot even though they say they’re “low cost”. Dr couldnt understand me when i clearly explained the reason i came to visit. didnt give an explanation as to why they would want to put him under and prescribe pain medication and she seemed uninterested.
I didn't like how they did my dog's nails. They only cut them and left them all chipped. Very bad service for 45 dollars. Horrible nails 😩 I don't recommend them for nails.

I recently fostered kittens with their umbilical cords still attached, and one of them was in a critical condition with severe inflammation and pus bursting out of the cord. I urgently searched for a place that could provide immediate treatment and found this clinic. I don't understand why the reviews are bad. The staff were incredibly kind, the facilities were very clean, and most importantly, the treatment fees were affordable so it wasn't a burden. They saved the kitten's life. Everyone had said there was no hope, but after visiting here and applying the prescribed medication and ointment, the kitten's condition improved rapidly. New skin grew, and today, it was declared fully recovered. Thank you for saving the kitten!!

Absolutely TERRIBLE experience.

The female veterinarian who works there, who I believe is the owner, was extremely rude, dismissive, and showed absolutely no compassion or concern for our dog. I was honestly shocked by how little effort she made to examine my dog.
She didn’t even bother properly holding her up to examine. She barely examined at all—no checking his eyes, ears, teeth, or even a proper basic physical examination. I have taken my dog to many veterinarians over the years, and this was by far one of the WORST veterinary experiences I have ever had.
What upset me the most was the complete lack of care and professionalism. When you take your pet to a veterinarian, you expect them to take the animal’s condition seriously and treat both the pet and the owner with basic respect. Unfortunately, we experienced none of that here.

I left feeling extremely disappointed and uncomfortable with the way our dog was treated. We will NEVER bring our dog back to this place again. If you genuinely care about your pet’s health and want a veterinarian who takes the time to properly examine and care for your animal, I would strongly recommend looking elsewhere.

I first took my dog on July 11th due to her left ear being red, so I suspect an ear infection. I felt Dr. Kim barely even took a look and stated a bug being trapped in the ear. My dog can come off as aggressive (she is 15 pounds and barks a lot) so I was told she would need to be sedated for the ear cleaning. I was also told antibiotic injections would be given to combat any possible infection.

The entire cost was almost $800. When I picked up my dog, I asked the front desk if any notes were left on what the possible reason could be as to why she had an infection, I was told it was inconclusive as a nothing was found in the ear.

A few days later I notice her ear was dirty again, so I cleaned it out myself and everything seemed to be fine.

The infection came back this month, this time on the left ear and shortly on the right. I decided to take my dog to a different vet. The new vet did a simple swap and tested it, my dog has had a yeast infection this whole time. (this time my dog was NOT sedated as the new vet found no reason and informed me of it being unnecessary as my dog allowed herself to have her ears cleaned out). My dog could have properly been diagnosed had the first vet ran the proper test instead of just unchanging me. This time I paid ¼ of the price. This office has astronomically high prices for low quality work.

Additionally, the new vet sent an email request on September 2nd asking for my dog’s medical records, no response was provided via email, so I called the office on September 9th to ask for medical records, I was told they would inform the vet and email me as soon as possible. I called again on September 12th to ask again, I was then told it would take up to 10 days. Medical records should be completed by the end of day and upon request should realistically take no more than 3 business days to be provided. This leads me to believe no medical notes are being documented.

I regret not reading the reviews for this place before, whatever you do, please do not take your pets here, the staff are kind and helpful, but the vet, Dr. Kim is the HUGE PROBLEM!
It was a place where everyone was so kind and everything was kept so clean.

Don’t ever come to this animal hospital ever!!!!! stay far away!!!! They infested my dog with fleas. They told me they were going to help get rid of her fleas with medication but instead they infested her, whatever they gave her made her situation worse. Instead of offering any sort of help they just said sorry and told me to buy shampoo. They’re the worse animal hospital. I would shut them down if I could. Horrible customer service.
Excellent!!!

I had such a wonderful experience at Western Animal Hospital! The facility is very clean and welcoming, and the entire staff was absolutely amazing. Everyone was so kind, attentive, and made both me and my pet feel comfortable from the moment we arrived.

Dr. Kim is truly such a caring and compassionate doctor. You can tell that she genuinely cares about her patients and takes the time to make sure both pets and their owners feel heard and taken care of.

I’m very grateful for the wonderful care we received and would definitely recommend Western Animal Hospital to anyone looking for a caring and trustworthy veterinary team!

I took my dog, Mai, to Western Animal Hospital and was very happy with the experience.

The hospital was very clean and organized, and the reception staff was friendly and attentive from the start. They explained the prices clearly before performing any procedures, so I knew exactly what to expect. I was very grateful that there were no unexpected charges.

The doctor took the time to examine Mai carefully and explained everything to me in a simple and honest way. I never felt rushed or that they were trying to recommend unnecessary tests or treatments. I truly felt that they cared about what was best for Mai.

It's not always easy to find a veterinary hospital that is clean, reasonably priced, and trustworthy. I'm so glad I found Western Animal Hospital. Both the staff and the doctor made Mai and me feel comfortable. I would definitely return and recommend it to other pet owners.

I have taken two of my cats to this location. Unfortunately, my most recent experience has been extremely disappointing and concerning.

My most recent cat was diagnosed with diabetes, and Dr. Le prescribed insulin for him. Approximately three weeks ago, his insulin dosage was adjusted based on his glucose levels. However, yesterday, my cat began experiencing seizures. I immediately took him to the emergency veterinarian, where I was informed that his glucose levels were dangerously low.

After his ER visit, I contacted Western Animal Hospital to explain the situation and determine the appropriate next steps for his care. I was then informed that they would no longer be able to provide care for my cat because the doctor who had been treating him was no longer servicing the clinic.

I find this situation extremely egregious, irresponsible, and unprofessional. Neither the doctor nor the clinic provided any advance notice that his care would be discontinued, despite the fact that he was an existing patient with an ongoing medical condition requiring continued monitoring and treatment. To learn this only after my cat experienced a potentially life-threatening emergency was extremely upsetting.

As a pet owner, I expect a veterinary clinic to prioritize the well-being and continuity of care of its patients. If a veterinarian is leaving a practice or is no longer available, clients with animals receiving ongoing treatment should be notified and provided with appropriate guidance or a referral to another veterinarian. Simply discontinuing care without adequate notice or assistance is unacceptable.

This experience has also left me questioning the level of medical care this clinic is prepared to provide. It seems as though they primarily take on routine services such as vaccinations, flea treatments, and occasional spay and neuter procedures, rather than providing consistent care for animals with more complex or ongoing medical needs. At this point, I would not feel comfortable trusting this clinic with the care of my pets.

The female veterinarian is incompetent, dismissive, and lacks empathy towards scared animals. The nurses here have no idea how to do their job either. Ended up leaving in the middle of my appointment and went elsewhere, where my pet and I were treated infinitely better.

I recently took my cat, Sky, to Western Animal Hospital because he suddenly developed a high fever and severe diarrhea. I was very worried because he became sick so quickly, but thanks to the fast response and treatment from Dr. Kim and the staff, he was feeling so much better within just one day. I was honestly surprised and very relieved to see him back to his normal self so quickly.

I have three cats, so over the years I have been to several different veterinary hospitals. What really stood out to me about Western Animal Hospital was how clearly everything was explained before treatment. The front desk staff was very kind and went over the estimate with me ahead of time, so I understood what the costs would be before making any decisions. I was also able to talk directly with Dr. Kim about Sky’s condition, the recommended tests, and treatment options.

At many other hospitals I have visited, I often felt like tests or treatments were done first and then I was simply handed an expensive bill afterward. Here, I never felt pressured. They took the time to explain what was necessary, what the options were, and what the expected costs would be. The pricing also felt very reasonable compared with other veterinary hospitals I have visited in Los Angeles.

The hospital itself was another pleasant surprise. Everything was extremely clean, organized, and comfortable, and you can tell they put a lot of effort into keeping the hospital welcoming for both pets and their owners.

Most importantly, I really appreciated how everyone treated Sky with care and how quickly they helped him when he was sick. Seeing him eating, acting normal, and feeling like himself again the next day was such a relief.

Sky and I are very thankful to Dr. Kim and all of the front staff at Western Animal Hospital for taking such good care of him. Having three cats, it is reassuring to finally find a veterinary hospital where I feel comfortable asking questions, discussing the cost beforehand, and knowing that my pets are in good hands. Thank you again for helping Sky feel better so quickly!

Horrible Veterinarian! Dr. Kim didn't care about my cat or any of my concerns. She rolled her eyes when I brought up my concern for my pet. She was too quick to charge us and get us out of the exam room. The front desk staff is very nice but this vet is absolutely horrible!  She shouldn't be a vet if she doesn't care about animals. Even the front desk staff said that she's normally rude with other patients as well and that's her usual attitude. It's extremely unprofessional!

This place is Very Clean!!!! ALL of the receptionist are very friendly and made me feel welcome.  They are open 7 days a week,  and the prices are very reasonable.  They were VERY gentle with my little girl Zoi, and the Dr. explained everything to me where I could understand it. I'd most definitely recommend this place for you animal needs.....👍👍👍👍

Western Animal Hospital is a VERY clean place. ALL of the receptionist were very friendly and make you feel welcome. They were VERY gentle with my little girl. The prices are reasonable. I'd most definitely recommend this place to take care of your dog or cat.
1st class

They have no bedside manner and seem like they are only interested in taking your money instead of helping. Never again will I go there or even recommend them. Just an awful experience! Excellent service and they treat the dogs well
Very professional.
Very kind staff and doctor. The hospital is clean and nice.

I am writing this review with a heavy heart to share my experience with this veterinary clinic, which I believe led to the tragic death of my beloved dog in 2020.

My dog began experiencing diarrhea, and I immediately took him to this clinic, seeking prompt and professional care. The veterinarian suspected liver cancer and recommended hospitalization. During his stay, he received only IV fluids and was force-fed through a syringe. Despite my growing concerns about his worsening condition and increasing abdominal swelling, I was assured that this was the best course of treatment.

After two agonizing days, my dog's condition deteriorated significantly, prompting me to insist on a transfer to an emergency room. It was there, with a simple physical examination, that it was evident my dog had a gallbladder issue that could have been treated with surgery. Sadly, due to the significant delay in diagnosis and appropriate treatment at this clinic, my dog's condition became critical, and he ultimately passed away.

The lack of accurate diagnosis and the critical delay in escalating his care resulted in a preventable tragedy. I am heartbroken and deeply disappointed by the treatment my dog received. I urge other pet owners to exercise extreme caution and seek a second opinion if you have any doubts about the diagnosis or treatment plan suggested here.
Don't go this vet please.

The staff here have been friendly and accommodating. I was able to call in and come an hour early from my appt time and they offer a good deal for the vaccinations we got, apparently they throw in a free de-worming when you get the full spectrum of wellness shots: rabies, bordetella, corona, and DHPPB. I paid $125 at the time of this post. Afterward they were helpful giving me the information I needed for my pet insurance and then I inquired about a last minute wellness checkup which they were able to schedule that same day. The checkup/ consult with dr is $60. We didn’t have to wait very long for the last minute consult. Maybe about 20 mins. The dr was nice as well. I opted to take the flea medication for $75 per the dr’s recommendation. Glad to get confirmation that my fur baby is healthy! ☺️👏🏽👏🏽👏🏽
Very clean and the staff are very friendly and attentive to dogs and other pets - the best!
Staff are very kind and considerate of our pets. Vaccines were quick and easy! ♡

Lexi. My family and I appreciate the entire staff. Reception ladies are the friendliest and most personable. Really makes a difference when making the unexpected calls to the vet. Thank you for your kind approach, you’re the heart of this hospital. The doctor seems to care and I trust that she does her best for our little ones with the truest intentions.

Thank you everyone at this clinic! The veterinarians take the time to listen carefully, explain procedures and options thoroughly, and answer questions with patience and kindness. You never feel rushed, and you always feel confident that your pet is receiving the best possible care. The support staff is equally impressive—organized, attentive, and always willing to go the extra mile to ensure appointments run smoothly.they really were able to give me plenty of options of treatments for when my dog was holding on during her senior years. You guys really made this easier for me and will appreciate it!
What truly sets this veterinary hospital apart is the compassion they show—not only to the pets but to their owners as well. The facility itself is outstanding. It is extremely clean, well-maintained, and efficiently run. Appointments are handled in a timely manner, wait times are minimal, and everything from check-in to checkout is seamless. The cleanliness of the hospital is immediately noticeable and very reassuring, reflecting the high standards they uphold in all aspects of care.
I always be thankful to all staff 🙏 for supporting me for the difficult times, for be there when I have been whit my heart broken for lossin my lovely Lillie.
I be thankful for ever 🙏
Gracias a todo su personal por su apoyo en mi momento de duelo pocas personas entenderan que es perder un ser querido asi pero ellos me entendieron fueron muy respetuosos  con mi dolor,gracias western animal hospital .

The clinic will also not attempt to care for your pet correctly and instead decide to charge you as much as possible for anesthetics and such. My baby🐱 is home recovering with couple of stitches. Price was reasonable. Everyone there is so friendly, felt very welcomed right when I walked in. Thank you for everything. my go to place for all my pets medical needs! All the staff members are super accommodating and friendly and of course answer any concerns I have! Dr Kim is super caring and has my dog feeling at ease and welcomed during every visit! Me and dog thank you guys for your service! 10/10!

Western animal hospital has a beautiful new facility and a very welcoming staff. We've been coming here for our two dogs for over 18 yrs.  Dr. Kim always explained the procedures clearly and guided us through everything we needed to do during each visit. Highly recommended!

I questioned whether this was appropriate behavior for an employee, and I was so offended that I transferred to another vet. No matter how good the vet's care, the staff's rudeness and arrogance can create a negative image for the hospital.
I feel sorry for Director Jennifer, who is such a kind person. 🤝

my cat was acting a little strange, and I decided to see the hospital for pets. once i found western animal hospital, they took in my cat. I watched their work and they handle the pets very carefully and well. my cat is aggressive, but seemed to ahve a likiing of the vets. my cat was diagnosed fast, and got treated so well.

i was devasted once i found out what happened to my dog, but i was blessed with this hospital diagnosing extremely fast. they amde my dog so much stronger and better than ever. I've seen how they care for them, and they treat the pets so nicely. thank you western animal hospital
The place was very nice, my dog went here and he is usually very aggressive but during the treatment he seemed very calm and wasn't wild. This is the most obedient I've seen him since a long time!

I want to take a moment to express how grateful I am for this animal hospital and the entire team who works here. From the moment we walked in, every staff member has been incredibly warm, patient, and truly caring. The hospital recently moved to a new location, and the facility is impressively large, modern, and spotless. It immediately gives you confidence that your pet is in good hands.

My dog is quite old and has multiple health issues, and at other clinics I was often told that there wasn’t much they could do because of his age. It was discouraging to feel like there were no real options to help him feel better. However, after coming to this hospital, everything changed. The doctors here took the time to examine him thoroughly, explain what was going on, and create a treatment plan that actually made a difference.

Since receiving care at this clinic, my dog’s condition has improved so much. He seems more comfortable, more active, and overall much happier. Watching him gain back some quality of life has meant the world to me, and I am genuinely thankful for the dedication and compassion the team has shown.

It is rare to find a place where both the medical expertise and the kindness of the staff stand out so clearly. I feel very fortunate to have found this hospital, and I would wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone who wants the best care for their pets.

This is the most incompetent veterinary clinic I have ever been to. I lost my best friend today because of their negligence.

Before surgery, my dog’s blood work already showed elevated BUN and creatinine, with calcium also slightly elevated—clear indicators that his kidneys were already under stress. This was visible on the first blood test, yet these results were never shared with me.

Despite these red flags, the veterinarian proceeded with anesthesia for what was supposed to be a simple ear hematoma repair. The anesthesia triggered a severe metabolic reaction, causing the calcium-regulating gland to go into overdrive, which led to acute renal failure. This sequence of events was preventable and should have been anticipated given the lab results.

Instead of taking responsibility, the veterinarian attempted to gaslight me, insisting my dog must have ingested poison such as antifreeze—despite the fact that I had eyes on him the entire time. This felt like an attempt to deflect blame rather than acknowledge the role their medical decisions played.

The staff was dismissive and unprofessional, especially the veterinarian. They did not welcome questions and seemed irritated when I asked for explanations. When my dog’s condition rapidly declined and they could no longer help him, they essentially told me to take him elsewhere so he was no longer their responsibility.

I am completely devastated. A procedure that was described as routine ended my best friend’s life because critical lab results were ignored and never discussed with me.

Never allow your pet to undergo anesthesia or surgery without reviewing blood work in detail with the veterinarian. If a clinic proceeds without full transparency or resists questions, walk away.

If I could give negative stars, I would.

this is a nice animal hospital-veterinarian. Dr Kim is very patient and professional while treating my dog pet. staff is very nice and helpful. Spanish is spoken so no problem with communicating any concerns. Plus I took advantage of their current special that for sure is already saving me money.

There's no reason not to visit here clean inside, kind team, and the prices were reasonable.
I've been to a few animal hospitals, but there's a reason I keep visiting here.
I really appreciate Dr. Kim for helping my dog.

I recently brought my ragdoll cat, Griffin, to Western Animal Hospital, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. From the moment we walked in, the staff was warm, patient, and incredibly welcoming.Griffin can be a little dramatic at the vet, but everyone treated him gently and made sure he felt safe and calm.

The doctors were thorough, explained everything clearly, and answered all my questions without rushing. You can tell they really care about their patients. Griffin left feeling relaxed, and I left feeling confident that he was in great hands

Overall, Western Animal Hospital provided amazing service, and I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a trustworthy and caring veterinary clinic for their pets Griffin approves too

I took my dog for the neuter surgery. Before I took him I was very concerned because he is bit aggressive. However, once I walked in to the clinic, I realized that I didn't have to worry about anything.  Whole staff are very nice and caring and they dealt with my dog very well even with his aggresive demeanor. The surgery went well thanks to Dr. Kim and my baby is recovering very well. They gave me thorough aftercare instructions which have helped me a lot. The whole experience was awesome and I also do appreciate the nice clean new clinic.

I’m honestly furious with how unprofessional this place is. They called me to say my pet’s medication was ready, so I called back right away and asked what time they close. I was told 7 PM and that coming before then was totally fine.

I got there 12 minutes before 7, and the entire place was already shut down. Doors locked, parking was closed, like they didn’t even bother to stay open until their own posted hours. What a complete waste of my time. If they stop pickups early or plan to close ahead of schedule, SAY THAT on the phone instead of misleading people.

This kind of poor communication is unacceptable, especially from a vet clinic people rely on. They clearly have zero respect for your time!
Excellent service

Avoid coming here at all cost. Dr. Kim is extremely rude and dismissive. Our dog needs surgery after Dr. Kim and her staff were medically incompetent in administrating 4 shots(instead of 2)in the wrong location of our dogs body. Our dog now has sepsis as a result of their carelessness and improper training. I have never witnessed such rude and unprofessional manner in any business/industry more than Dr. Kim’s veterinary practice. I am also currently pursuing legal action against them.

Since they moved across the street.. atleast look more cleaner..( 5 months ago>Staff there ALWAYS in a hurry... don't pay much attention to your pet... when the vet examines the pet.. for the money they charge, they should do a better job with clients.. considering moving to another pet hospital.

My dog ​​had surgery and received excellent care. She's doing well now. The doctor and staff are wonderful.

We’ve been bringing our pets and have always appreciated the care from Dr. Kim and the medical team. When I called the clinic with a concern, the front desk staff member Marissa hung up on me 10  times. When I finally addressed her behavior in person, she laughed at me, raised her voice, and publicly told me I was "not like a customer" in front of several other people in the waiting room. I was shocked, humiliated, and honestly heartbroken -- especially from a place I had trusted with my pets for years.

Regardless of how busy a clinic may be, this level of disrespect and unprofessionalism is unacceptable. I've never been treated so poorly while simply trying to advocate for my pet.

The veterinarians may be competent, but no one should have to deal with a front desk person who acts this way toward loyal clients. I hope management takes this feedback seriously because this kind of behavior drives good clients away. And Modern Animal Hospital charges $200 membership with unlimited free exams. You guys are not in the right mindset for success. Good luck at your new location. No one will come back!

Thank you for all of your hard work, Western Animal Hospital team!

- José and Geena Davis

They are really good there and I had to put my service dog down there she had liver problems and was clearly in pain. She was pooping blood at the end so I knew it was time to put her down. It was one of the hardest and saddest thing I've ever had to do. I was really close to her and she was really close to me. I actually could read her thoughts it was a weird thing but I knew exactly what she wanted when she would look at me. I have never been that close to an animal before it was as bad as loosing my mother to cancer. It felt like the same feeling because I watched my mom and my dog go from looking right to withered down to nothing. It was awful. I'm still grieving my dog.
